title: Tencent Responds to the Restructuring of IEG AI Game Department: Report Contains Serious Inaccuracies; Establishing a New Department Is a Misinterpretation

content_html:
On August 26, in response to reports that Tencent's Interactive Entertainment Group (IEG) is reorganizing its AI gaming department, integrating the ARC Lab under IEG CROS (Tencent Game Technology Middle Platform) with the Game AI Engine Department, and planning to expand the team to 400-500 people, a relevant person from Tencent clearly stated that the content contains many inaccuracies, and the so-called "establishment of a new department" is a misunderstanding.

Tencent stated that the Game AI Engine Department was originally part of the public technology line of the company, and has long been recruiting AI professionals globally. The core responsibilities of this department focus on AI technology efficiency enhancement and gameplay innovation in the game development and operation process, aiming to provide reusable underlying technical capabilities and standardized solutions for various internal game projects.

With the rapid iteration of generative AI and computer graphics technologies, game development is undergoing a deep transformation, shifting from R&D support to a full-process intelligent restructuring. The construction of the public technology middle platform has become a core support for leading manufacturers to reduce repeated R&D costs and promote the implementation of innovative gameplay. Tencent's clarification on the positioning of the AI engine department demonstrates its strategic resilience in existing technical pipeline planning, and also reflects the rational framework of large companies in the game industry's AI empowerment, shifting from "scale expansion" to "deep integration and practical efficiency enhancement."
